<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Core Features

The base and important some features in plugin

Strong Storage

The plugin has 3 different storage systems to choose from.
MySQL, SQLite, RozsDBLite

%100 Configurable

You can customize all menus, messages, and other options.
This way, you can customize all messages as you wish while entering the settings via YAML or TAML.

Plugin Integration

RClaim works in parallel with many plugins, allowing it to work alongside well-known plugins such as Economy, Dynmap, Map, Combat, Stacker, and Farmer.
And, Hologram support is available via external plugins.
Is there a plugin it doesn't work with?
Let us know

Chunk-Based Claim System

RClaim is a new generation claim system that works with chunks instead of the old-style shovel selection system.
This ensures that players do not experience performance issues.

Advanced User Management

You can customize user permissions as you wish.
After adding the user to your claim request, you can grant personalized permissions or assign create groups that grant permissions to that group, thereby offering extended permissions.

GUI-Based Expansion

It features an advanced, all-in-one interface that is completely simple and easy to use for players.
Instead of a text-based system, you can manage your claim system with an interface that clearly explains what everything is.

Pictures From Plugin

Below are photos of some features.

Claim indicator

You can create an indicator with two different options to show players their areas.

Hologram Support

With hologram support, you can display information related to claims to claim holders.
Hologram support is provided through external plugins.
FancyHologram and DecentHologram are supported.

Claim settings

You can add several settings within the claim to ensure claim security.
These settings can be expanded via the API.
The current ones are:
PVP, EXPLOSION, ANIMAL SPAWN, MONSTER SPAWN, WATER AND LAVA PLACEMENT, TIME AND WEATHER

Menu support

The claim plugin includes fully customizable and functional GUI support.

Claim Management

Other Integrations

The plugin includes integrations with plugins such as WorldGuard, CombatPvP, Dynmap, and PlaceholderAPI.

Claim Effects

Purchase claim effects that players can only use within the claim.
Level and pricing are fully customizable.

GUI-based expansion

A GUI-based expansion mechanism that allows users to easily expand their areas and monitor them via the GUI.

Resize your claim

Custom Permissions & Roles

The add-on features an extensive permission system.
It includes the “Claim Tag” feature, which allows you to create roles within the add-on, assign permissions to these roles, and manage players collectively.
You can also set up individual permissions!
